2610.06668.title: Language models can notice an impossible engineering problem yet still report it as solved
2610.06668.paper_summary: Language models draft engineering calculations, but answer accuracy does not show whether they reject an impossible problem. We tested 14 models on 30 pairs of mechanics problems, each with a valid version and one made impossible by changing a given value or assumption. Two independent solvers verified every answer key and showed that each flawed problem was physically impossible. We scored solving of valid problems separately from rejection of their flawed counterparts. Each reply required a "solved" or "cannot solve" status; rejection meant "cannot solve" or withholding an answer. The initial prompts did not warn that problems could be flawed. Across three recent models, 12 of 90 replies failed to reject a flawed problem. In 11 of these replies, the model stated the flaw, answered a corrected problem and still reported the original as "solved", according to artificial intelligence raters and numerical checks. We later retested four models from one provider, offering "flawed" instead of "cannot solve" and asking them to name and explain the defect. Three models showed statistically significant increases in rejection, but valid-problem solving fell in three. Evaluations therefore need to score both versions and distinguish flaw recognition from the reported status.
2610.06668.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型草擬工程計算，但答案的準確性並未顯示它們是否拒絕不可能的問題。我們測試了 14 個模型，針對 30 對力學問題，每對問題都有一個有效版本和一個因改變給定值或假設而變得不可能的版本。兩位獨立的解題者驗證了每個答案鍵，並顯示每個有缺陷的問題在物理上都是不可能的。我們將有效問題的解題與拒絕其有缺陷對應物的情況分開計分。每個回覆都需要一個「已解決」或「無法解決」的狀態；拒絕意味著「無法解決」或不提供答案。最初的提示並未警告問題可能存在缺陷。在三個最近的模型中，90 個回覆中有 12 個未能拒絕一個有缺陷的問題。在這 11 個回覆中，模型指出了缺陷，回答了一個修正過的問題，並仍然將原始問題報告為「已解決」，根據人工智慧評估者和數值檢查。我們後來重新測試了來自一個提供者的四個模型，提供「有缺陷」而不是「無法解決」，並要求它們命名並解釋缺陷。三個模型顯示拒絕的統計顯著增加，但有效問題的解題在三個模型中下降。因此，評估需要同時對兩個版本進行計分，並區分缺陷識別與報告狀態。
2610.06668.author: Shaoliang Yang et.al.
